stem_book: A solid cylinder of mass m and radius R is given angular velocity ω₀ and kept on a horizontal rough surface (coefficient of friction μ). The initial velocity is zero. Find out the distance travelled by the cylinder before it performs pure rolling and the work done by friction forces.
reason: Two-part question with separate answers (distance and work); printed key agrees. Solid cylinder, μ, m, R assumed (not stated in print).
work: v = μgt, ωR = ω₀R − 2μgt ⇒ t = ω₀R/(3μg), v = ω₀R/3; S = v²/(2μg) = ω₀²R²/(18μg); W = ½mv² + ¼mR²(ω₀/3)² − ¼mR²ω₀² = −mω₀²R²/6
